inspection_method: Each original opened separately; each final .w640.png, .w331.png and .w342.png viewed individually as actual isolated-headless Chromium screenshots. Native PNG/SVG outputs are scratch candidates, not promoted figures.

observations: Left solid wall and solid-side hatching remain distinct from right/below liquid.
Wall-raised meniscus flattens rightward; downward-right contact tangent and downward wall bound the acute liquid-side theta.
Theta and Liquid are separated from curve/tangent/hatching and fit at each actual width.
No source numerical angle invented; no zero-angle-limit assertion, wall gap, membrane or arrow.
figures.limits: Qualitative layout angle, not source measurement. English Liquid is an explicit modern identification addition.

observations: Wall-lowered meniscus rises rightward; upward-right tangent and downward wall enclose the obtuse liquid-side sector.
Theta remains within the liquid-side angular region and is clear of the arc after the single label-only repair.
Liquid area touches the wall; no false gas gap or acute gas-side-supplement annotation.
Actual-width theta/Liquid glyphs are legible and fit.
figures.repair: Initial native-render theta/arc collision preserved. Only theta.at moved from screen (220,300) to (198,310); all contact geometry unchanged.
figures.limits: Finite arc is a tangent-angle construction, not a measured fluid contour or the 180-degree quantitative limit.

observations: Four open upright tubes remain in one reservoir, with common exterior level and visible inner/outer walls.
Concave menisci, narrower left-to-right bores and greater rises are distinguishable at all actual widths.
The single repair stops the reservoir rim at tube exterior walls; it no longer crosses the capillary liquid interiors.
Tube lower ends remain open to shared liquid; Water label is clear of the vessel boundary and >=16px.
figures.repair: Initial actual-width output retained. Only reservoir-wall.d rim intervals changed; bores, menisci, heights, labels and assertions unchanged.
figures.limits: Source fourth narrow meniscus has dark-pixel ambiguity. This is the prose-qualified uncalibrated same-liquid/material/static inverse-radius model, not a traced numerical dataset.

observations: Two tube sides, elliptical circular contact rim and concave bowl profile are visible.
Nine rear and eight front arrows visibly point up from the contact boundary; endpoint arrows remain inside the canvas at each width.
Liquid lies below/outside the meniscus bowl, distinguished by fill and horizontal texture; Liquid label does not cover the profile.
No elastic membrane, velocity/flow arrow, numerical force, radius label or calibration added.
figures.limits: Source left-front arrow partially merges with wall ink; the discernible arrow is retained. Regularized arrow spacing/lengths are illustrative forces, not data.

observations: Four open tubes share one reservoir and exterior liquid level.
All four convex meniscus tops lie below the exterior level; smaller bores depict larger positive depression magnitudes.
No downward depth is mislabeled as a positive signed upward height; no h/measurement labels are added.
Convex profiles, liquid/air contrast and Mercury identification remain visible at all actual widths.
figures.limits: Merged source black fill does not establish exact third/fourth pixel-depth ratios. Current complete-nonwetting static model is an uncalibrated regularization, not a claim for arbitrary partial nonwetting.

observations: Uneven ground, interrupted mouths and two narrow surface-connected pores are visible.
Both wet pore regions retain horizontal liquid texture; left widens toward its lower branch, right slopes downward-left.
Irregular grain curves and branching relationships match the source schematic rather than a generated generic soil image.
Soil and Water remain clear after one label/leader-clearance repair; the identification leader has no arrowhead.
No flow arrows, measured water route, water table, time, grid or calibrated pore size added.
figures.repair: Initial native-render Water/pore-boundary collision retained. Only Water text screen y296->332 and leader outer endpoint (530,285)->(552,303) changed; the pore-side endpoint (506,264) and all soil/liquid geometry stay unchanged.
figures.limits: This is an unmeasured pore/soil cross-section schematic; it does not determine a unique real soil-flow route.

limits: Author self-check observations only, not independent figure or SCI PASS. No promotion/finalization. No repeat n47 science gate. All task-owned browser launches were isolated/headless, external preview network aborted, browsers closed.
